title: 1 Thessalonians
author: Paul the apostle with Silvanus and Timothy.
historicalSetting: Paul encourages a young church in faith, holiness, endurance, and hope in Christ's return.
keyVerse: 1 Thessalonians 4:16 — "For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout."
christFocus: First Thessalonians points believers to Christ as Savior, sanctifier, and returning Lord who strengthens hope and holiness.
outline: Holy living and Christ's return — 1 Thessalonians 4-5
